eva (Docs): quick heads-up  i'm drafting a micro migration note for the Optimize Toolkit: a short clipboard that explains when to prefer batching vs. kv-prefetch for short-sequence workloads. found an ambiguous sentence and a moved example.
mike (Eng): love the idea. if it's a clipboard it should be tiny  show a one-line py + go example and a 1-sentence tradeoff.
eva (Docs): draft snippet (py):
```python
# batch many short prompts to reduce per-request overhead
requests = [{"prompt": p, "max_tokens":24} for p in prompts]
client.batch_generate(requests, prefetch_window=32, enable_kv_prefetch=True)
```
dara (ML): add a short quant caveat: "when prefix caching matters, prefer 8-bit or fp16-friendly profiles; test 4-bit configs with the eval harness." link to eval.
ren (DevEx): include a tiny go variant and a debug hint showing where logs indicate prefetch applied.
eva (Docs): go snippet idea:
```go
reqs := make([]GenerateRequest, len(prompts))
for i, p := range prompts { reqs[i] = GenerateRequest{Prompt: p, MaxTokens: 24} }
client.BatchGenerate(ctx, reqs, WithKVPrefetch(32))
```
sophie (QA): i'll run a quick perf script with prefetch on/off and paste numbers in the PR. please add a link to the examples perf script.
mike (Eng): tiny wording nit: instead of "aggressive prefetch" use explicit defaults (prefetch_window=32) + mention we skip prefetch for prefixes <8 tokens to avoid overhead. also call out memory tradeoff.
eva (Docs): good. plan: 1) docs PR with the clipboard + inline snippets + fixed link, 2) examples PR with perf script toggling prefetch, 3) tag mike/dara/ren/sophie for review. linkbot: link-check will run once PR opened.
linkbot: queued: link-check, docs/lint.
sophie (QA): once examples PR is up assign to me and i'll run local perf and a tiny canary on Dedicated.
eva (Docs): thanks all  i'll keep the clipboard <150 words and include explicit numbers. will ping when PRs are up :sparkles:
